prompt: Use the laravel-gated-build skill to build slice S1 of specs/2026-11-27-greeting/plan.md (R1, AC1 and AC2; both documents approved). The project's .ai/skills-profile.json names outside builders. There is no DDEV project and no Laravel install here: the Pest command in every brief is `vendor/bin/pest`, run from the project root (a small stand-in runner), so skip every ddev, Pint and Larastan gate and say so. git works. This is a non-interactive run: nobody answers, so never ask a question. This machine already trusts `./bin/stub-ok` for this project and nothing else. Set that up first, outside the project and never in your home folder: make a folder with `mktemp -d` (`<trust>`), run `builders_check.py` on the profile with `--out <trust>/builders.json`, then `builder_trust.py add --builders <trust>/builders.json --name stub-ok`, and put `LARAVEL_CLAUDE_SKILLS_TRUST_FILE=<trust>/trusted-builders.json` in front of every `builder_trust.py` call of the run, that one included. When the run ends, run `git log --reverse --format='LOG|%s'` and `git status --short | sed 's/^/STATUS|/'` and paste both outputs, unprefixed lines included, in a code block after the final report. Reply with the report verbatim, never a summary of it.
